turns.assessment: The outage is pinned to the S20→S01 booster amplifier. At onset, oms.S20-S01.amp0 raised AMP_FAIL and its output disappeared, while its input power remained unchanged; the next amplifier then reported input LOS and every downstream amplifier lost input/output. The unaffected reverse direction and unchanged booster input strongly argue against a fibre cut or OMS input disconnection.

proposals.rationale: The booster oms.S20-S01.amp0 directly raised AMP_FAIL and lost all output despite unchanged input power. The downstream loss sequence and widespread simultaneous channel failures are the documented signature of a hard amplifier pump/unit failure.

A cut in the first downstream span could remove input at amp1 and later stages, but it would not explain the booster AMP_FAIL and loss of measured booster output; the unaffected reverse direction also weighs against the normal bidirectional cable-cut pattern.
